unit.title: Incredible India & Travel
unit.about_unit: Celebrates cultural, linguistic, and geographic diversity across India—from the coastal tip of Kanyakumari to the high-altitude cold deserts of Ladakh.

facilitation_guide.headline: Cultural Appreciation
facilitation_guide.text: Explore harvest festivals and indigenous clothing styles across states.

facilitation_guide.headline: Extreme Shelters
facilitation_guide.text: Examine how homes (Rebo tents, houseboats, mud dwellings) adapt to geography.

chapter.title: Incredible India
chapter.tagline: Exploring the cultural, geographic, linguistic, and festive tapestry of a unified India
chapter.overview: From the snow-clad peaks of the Himalayas to the coastal shores of the south, children explore how India's remarkable physical diversity fosters unique languages, traditional attire, harvest festivals (Bihu, Pongal, Baisakhi, Onam), and harmonious community living.

sections.title: Unity in Diversity: Languages, Attire, and Terrains
sections.subtitle: How geographic variety shapes regional lifestyles

storyNarrative.dialogue: Look at our map of India: we speak dozens of languages, wear phiran, mundu, or saree, yet we all sing the same national anthem with pride!

concept.heading: Plurality and Constitutional Unity
concept.keyRule: India's unity in diversity is rooted in mutual respect, shared history, and cooperative federalism across diverse regional traditions.

sections.title: Harvest Festivals: Celebrating Nature's Bounty
sections.subtitle: Baisakhi, Pongal, Makar Sankranti, Bihu, and Onam

storyNarrative.dialogue: In January and spring, when the crops are reaped, people across every state thank nature—Bihu in Assam, Pongal in Tamil Nadu, and Baisakhi in Punjab!

storyNarrative.dialogue: In Ladakh, our houses use stone and mud bricks that stay warm in -20°C winter, while in Kerala, houses feature slanted tile roofs for torrential rain!
